source_references.title: Modernizing member engagement through digital platforms: PwC

business_problem: SHRM needed to replace a fragmented, transactional member experience with a connected digital platform that could personalize journeys, modernize commerce, and support growth for a global membership base.
solution_summary: SHRM replaced a fragmented, one-size-fits-all digital experience with an Adobe-based engagement and commerce platform designed around personalization. PwC helped unify data across SHRM’s enterprise systems and implemented Adobe Experience Manager, Adobe Commerce, and Adobe Real-Time CDP so member interactions, content delivery, product recommendations, and checkout all operate from a connected profile and analytics foundation. Personalization AI uses real-time engagement behavior to guide what resources, experiences, and offers members see, while the commerce stack supports fast, low-friction purchase flows for learning, certification, and other services. The program was built with a member-first operating model, mapping journeys and pain points before implementation and then feeding live usage data back into continuous improvement. The result is a digital platform that can orchestrate tailored journeys globally while giving teams a unified view of how and why members engage.

solution_components.name: Adobe Experience Manager
solution_components.role: Delivers the digital content and member-facing experience layer for SHRM’s new platform.

solution_components.name: Adobe Commerce
solution_components.role: Runs the digital commerce flow for certification, learning, and other member transactions.

solution_components.name: Adobe Real-Time CDP
solution_components.role: Unifies member data and engagement signals into connected profiles that support personalization.

solution_components.name: advanced personalization AI
solution_components.role: Uses real-time behavior to tailor content, recommendations, and next-best experiences for members.

data_flow: Member, commerce, and engagement data from SHRM’s enterprise systems flows into Adobe Real-Time CDP, where profiles are unified and activation signals are shared with Adobe Experience Manager and Adobe Commerce. Personalization AI uses real-time behavior to tailor content, recommendations, and checkout experiences, while analytics feed continuous improvement of member journeys.
business_outcome: SHRM gained a unified view of members, faster site and checkout performance, better conversion and retention potential, and a digital platform that can deliver personalized journeys to a global membership community.
architecture_clues: Adobe Real-Time CDP creates unified profiles from SHRM’s enterprise data.
Adobe Commerce supports the fast, low-friction checkout experience that reduced abandonment.
Member journeys are refined continuously using real-time engagement analytics and feedback.
The platform supports both digital content delivery and commerce from one connected foundation.
evidence_quotes: By unifying data across enterprise systems and leveraging advanced personalization AI, PwC helped SHRM to deliver the required resources, the right experiences, and the appropriate product recommendations through a seamless, lightning-fast checkout experience that ultimately enabled us to create a more connected, engaging member journey.
We now have a unified view of our members and thorough analytics on when, how, and why they choose SHRM.
With the new, enriched data, our teams can continuously curate and orchestrate personalized journeys based on real-time engagement activity.
SHRM’s Lighthouse Performance Score jumped 52 points, reflecting major gains in speed, accessibility, and user experience.
Page load times dropped by 43%. End-to-end checkout speed also improved by 65%.
